   311	  function _deepFreeze(v) {
   312	    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
   313	    try { _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(v); } catch (e) { /* swallow */ }
   314	    var keys;
   315	    try { keys = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(v); } catch (e) { return v; }
   316	    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
   317	      var k = keys[i];
   318	      var child;
   319	      try { child = v[k]; } catch (eGet) { continue; }
   320	      _deepFreeze(child);
   321	    }
   322	    return v;
   323	  }

   325	  // ---------- Input descriptor snapshot --------------------------------------------------------
   326	  // Mirrors D5 snapshotInputDescriptors: walks own descriptors (NOT [[Get]]) so a Proxy with
   327	  // hostile getters does NOT fire on first read. Symbol / non-enumerable / accessor / unknown
   328	  // own key → reject before any further inspection.
   329	  function _snapshotPlainShape(o, allowedKeys, invalidCode, opts) {
   330	    opts = opts || {};
   331	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(o)) {
   332	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED], detail: 'not plain' };
   333	    }
   334	    if (opts.requireFrozen && _isFrozenSafe(o) !== true) {
   335	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not frozen' };
   336	    }
   337	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(o)) {
   338	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key' };
   339	    }
   340	    var names;
   341	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(o); } catch (e) {
   342	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor read failed' };
   343	    }
   344	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   345	    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
   346	      var k = names[i];
   347	      // Reject unknown own key — caller cannot smuggle `class`, `outcomeId`, `confounders`,
   348	      // etc. into the input wrapper.
   349	      if (allowedKeys.indexOf(k) === -1) {
   350	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'unknown own key ' + k };
   351	      }
   352	      var d;
   353	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(o, k); } catch (e) {
   354	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor inaccessible' };
   355	      }
   356	      if (!d || d.enumerable !== true) {
   357	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable key ' + k };
   358	      }
   359	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   360	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor key ' + k };
   361	      }
   362	      snap[k] = d.value;
   363	    }
   364	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   365	  }
   366	
   367	  // Codex E3-R1-03 closure: dense-array enforcement. Reject sparse arrays (any index in
   368	  // 0..length-1 missing an enumerable data descriptor → hole) AND reject any own key
   369	  // other than 'length' or a canonical numeric index (no Symbol keys, no string names,
   370	  // no negative / fractional / leading-zero indices). The walk indexes BY index, not by
   371	  // getOwnPropertyNames enumeration order, so a hostile array that puts named own keys
   372	  // first cannot smuggle a hole past the cap check.
   373	  function _snapshotArrayShape(a, invalidCode) {
   374	    if (!_isPlainArray(a)) {
   375	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not array' };
   376	    }
   377	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(a)) {
   378	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key on array' };
   379	    }
   380	    var aLen;
   381	    try { aLen = a.length; } catch (e) {
   382	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array length inaccessible' };
   383	    }
   384	    if (typeof aLen !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(aLen) || aLen < 0 || aLen > ARRAY_CAP) {
   385	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.ARRAY_CAP_EXCEEDED], detail: 'array len ' + aLen };
   386	    }
   387	    // First sweep: enumerate own keys and reject ANY name other than 'length' or a
   388	    // canonical numeric index in [0, aLen). Reject Symbol keys (already above), reject
   389	    // non-enumerable / accessor / non-data descriptors on indices.
   390	    var names;
   391	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(a); } catch (e) {
   392	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array desc inaccessible' };
   393	    }
   394	    for (var ni = 0; ni < names.length; ni++) {
   395	      var nm = names[ni];
   396	      if (nm === 'length') continue;
   397	      if (!ARRAY_INDEX_RE.test(nm)) {
   398	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'non-index own key on array: ' + nm };
   399	      }
   400	      var idxN = +nm;
   401	      if (idxN < 0 || idxN >= aLen) {
   402	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array index out of [0,length): ' + nm };
   403	      }
   404	      var dn;
   405	      try { dn = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, nm); } catch (e) {
   406	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail' };
   407	      }
   408	      if (!dn || dn.enumerable !== true) {
   409	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + nm };
   410	      }
   411	      if (typeof dn.get === 'function' || typeof dn.set === 'function') {
   412	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + nm };
   413	      }
   414	    }
   415	    // Second sweep: walk by index 0..aLen-1. Every index MUST have an OWN enumerable
   416	    // data descriptor (no holes, no prototype-inherited values).
   417	    var snap = [];
   418	    for (var i = 0; i < aLen; i++) {
   419	      var key = '' + i;
   420	      var d;
   421	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, key); } catch (e) {
   422	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail at ' + i };
   423	      }
   424	      if (!d) {
   425	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'sparse array hole at index ' + i };
   426	      }
   427	      if (d.enumerable !== true) {
   428	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + i };
   429	      }
   430	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   431	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + i };
   432	      }
   433	      snap.push(d.value);
   434	    }
   435	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   436	  }

   458	  // ---------- Deterministic ID generator -------------------------------------------------------
   459	  // outcomeId is deterministic from (experimentId, changeId). No clock leak.
   460	  function _hash32(s) {
   461	    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
   462	    var len = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   463	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   464	      h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
   465	      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
   466	    }
   467	    return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
   468	  }
   469	  function _fnv2(s) {
   470	    var slen = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   471	    return _hash32(s) + _hash32(s + '|' + slen);
   472	  }
   473	  function _outcomeId(experimentId, changeId) {
   474	    return 'outcome_' + _fnv2('outcome|' + experimentId + '|' + changeId);

   477	  // ---------- Main entry: classifyOutcome -----------------------------------------------------
   478	  /**
   479	   * classifyOutcome(input, opts) — produces a deep-frozen Outcome envelope.
   480	   *
   481	   * Ordered steps (clock MUST NOT fire before Step 9):
   482	   *   0.  intrinsic integrity (captures + contract surfaces still frozen)
   483	   *   1.  input wrapper descriptor snapshot (closed keys; symbol/accessor/proxy rejected)
   484	   *   2.  experiment frozen + E1 shape validation
   485	   *   3.  appliedChange snapshot + shape
   486	   *   4.  followUp snapshot + shape
   487	   *   5.  observation snapshot + shape
   488	   *   6.  controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 shape
   489	   *   7.  opts snapshot
   490	   *   8.  identity binding (status=applied, sourceExperimentId match, parentCaseId match)
   491	   *   9.  resolve freshness reference time (clock at most once)
   492	   *   10. freshness check on experiment.createdAt + appliedChange.appliedAt
   493	   *   11. comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence)
   494	   *   12. control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders precedence)
   495	   *   13. data-quality + direction/magnitude classification cascade
   496	   *   14. compose outcome
   497	   *   15. validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape
   498	   *   16. envelope byte cap
   499	   *   17. deep-freeze + register
   500	   */
   501	  function classifyOutcome(inputIn, optsIn) {
   502	    try {
   503	      // ---- Step 0: intrinsic integrity ----------------------------------------------------
   504	      if (!_intrinsicsIntact()) {
   505	        return _buildTamperBlock('intrinsic tampering detected at entry');
   506	      }
   507	
   508	      // ---- Step 1: input wrapper descriptor snapshot -------------------------------------
   509	      var inSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputIn, INPUT_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, { requireFrozen: false });
   510	      if (inSnapR.valid !== true) {
   511	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(inSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: inSnapR.detail });
   512	      }
   513	      var inputSnap = inSnapR.snapshot;
   514	
   515	      // ---- Step 2: experiment shape validation -------------------------------------------
   516	      // The Experiment must be deep-frozen (immutability) AND pass the E1 contract.
   517	      if (!_isFrozenSafe(inputSnap.experiment)) {
   518	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.EXPERIMENT_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment not deep-frozen' });
   519	      }
   520	      var expCheck = EXP.validateExperimentShape(inputSnap.experiment);
   521	      if (expCheck.valid !== true) {
   522	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(
   523	          expCheck.reasonCodes ? expCheck.reasonCodes.slice() : [CODES.EXPERIMENT_INVALID],
   524	          { detail: 'experiment shape invalid' }
   525	        );
   526	      }
   527	      var experiment = inputSnap.experiment;
   528	
   529	      // ---- Step 3: appliedChange snapshot + shape ----------------------------------------
   530	      var acSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.appliedChange, APPLIED_CHANGE_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   531	      if (acSnapR.valid !== true) {
   532	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(acSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'appliedChange: ' + acSnapR.detail });
   533	      }
   534	      var appliedChange = acSnapR.snapshot;
   535	      if (!_idGrammarOk(appliedChange.changeId)) {
   536	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.changeId invalid' });
   537	      }
   538	      if (!_idGrammarOk(appliedChange.sourceExperimentId)) {
   539	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.sourceExperimentId invalid' });
   540	      }
   541	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(appliedChange.appliedAt) || _isoToMs(appliedChange.appliedAt) === null) {
   542	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.appliedAt invalid' });
   543	      }
   544	
   545	      // ---- Step 4: followUp snapshot + shape ---------------------------------------------
   546	      var fuSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.followUp, FOLLOWUP_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   547	      if (fuSnapR.valid !== true) {
   548	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(fuSnapR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'followUp: ' + fuSnapR.detail });
   549	      }
   550	      var followUp = fuSnapR.snapshot;
   551	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.followUpCaseId)) {
   552	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.followUpCaseId invalid' });
   553	      }
   554	      if (!_idGrammarOk(followUp.parentCaseId)) {

   556	      }
   557	      if (followUp.parentCaseId === followUp.followUpCaseId) {

   562	      }

   565	      }
   566	      if (!_isBool(followUp.hasExplicitReference)) {

   568	      }

   571	      }

   574	      var obsSnapR = _snapshotPlainShape(inputSnap.observation, OBSERVATION_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);

   605	        }

    35	function deepFreeze(v) {
    36	  if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
    37	  Object.freeze(v);
    38	  var names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v);
    39	  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) deepFreeze(v[names[i]]);
    40	  return v;
    41	}

   709	        if (!_idGrammarOk(contradictingEvidenceIds[ci])) {
   710	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'contradictingEvidenceIds[' + ci + '] invalid id' });
   711	        }
   712	      }
   713	      var supR = _snapshotArrayShape(observation.supportingEvidenceIds, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   714	      if (supR.valid !== true) {
   715	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(supR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'supportingEvidenceIds: ' + supR.detail });
   716	      }

   718	      for (var sii = 0; sii < supportingEvidenceIds.length; sii++) {
   719	        if (!_idGrammarOk(supportingEvidenceIds[sii])) {
   720	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'supportingEvidenceIds[' + sii + '] invalid id' });
   721	        }
   722	      }
   723	
   724	      // ---- Step 6: controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 -----------------
   725	      var cvObsR = _snapshotArrayShape(inputSnap.controlVariableObservations, CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLES_INVALID);
   726	      if (cvObsR.valid !== true) {
   727	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(cvObsR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'controlVariableObservations: ' + cvObsR.detail });
   728	      }
   729	      var controlVariableObservations = cvObsR.snapshot;
   730	      // E1 contract per element. The CV contract permits observedValue + withinRange filled.
   731	      // Codex E3-R1-01 closure: observed-CV membership is tracked via a captured null-proto
   732	      // set with descriptor-based membership; an ambient Object.create rebind cannot
   733	      // synthesize membership entries because we use the captured Object.create + the
   734	      // captured Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor for has-checks.
   735	      var observedCvSet = _newCapturedNullSet();
   736	      for (var cvi = 0; cvi < controlVariableObservations.length; cvi++) {
   737	        var cvObs = controlVariableObservations[cvi];
   738	        var cvCheck = CV.validateControlVariableShape(cvObs);
   739	        if (cvCheck.valid !== true) {
   740	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(
   741	            cvCheck.reasonCodes ? cvCheck.reasonCodes.slice() : [CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLES_INVALID],
   742	            { detail: 'controlVariableObservations[' + cvi + '] shape invalid' }
   743	          );
   744	        }
   745	        // E3 additionally requires observedValue + withinRange to be filled (non-null) — the
   746	        // E1 contract permits null for shape-only validation; E3 algorithm demands the
   747	        // observation be present so the integrity check can run.
   748	        if (cvObs.observedValue === null) {
   749	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING], { detail: 'controlVariableObservations[' + cvi + '].observedValue null' });
   750	        }
   751	        if (cvObs.withinRange === null) {
   752	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING], { detail: 'controlVariableObservations[' + cvi + '].withinRange null' });
   753	        }
   754	        if (_capturedSetHas(observedCvSet, cvObs.name)) {
   755	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLES_INVALID], { detail: 'duplicate control variable name: ' + cvObs.name });
   756	        }
   757	        _capturedSetAdd(observedCvSet, cvObs.name);
   758	      }
   759	
   760	      // ---- Step 7: opts snapshot ----------------------------------------------------------
   761	      var optsR = _snapshotOpts(optsIn);
   762	      if (optsR.valid !== true) {
   763	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(optsR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'opts: ' + optsR.detail });
   764	      }
   765	      var optsSnap = optsR.snapshot;
   766	
   767	      // ---- Step 8: identity binding -------------------------------------------------------
   768	      if (experiment.status !== 'applied') {
   769	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.EXPERIMENT_STATUS_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment.status must be applied to classify, got ' + experiment.status });
   770	      }
   771	      if (experiment.outcome !== null) {
   772	        // Defence-in-depth: E1 contract already enforces outcome=null for status=applied,
   773	        // but caller-supplied final classification is forbidden, so the classifier rejects
   774	        // any pre-filled outcome explicitly here too.
   775	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'caller-supplied experiment.outcome forbidden at classification' });
   776	      }
   777	      if (appliedChange.sourceExperimentId !== experiment.experimentId) {
   778	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange.sourceExperimentId !== experiment.experimentId' });
   779	      }
   780	      // Codex E3-R3-01 closure: experiment.followUpCaseIds MUST pass the dense-array
   781	      // snapshot (E1's nested-descriptor audit does not catch sparse arrays — sparse
   782	      // [] enumerates only 'length' and slips through). Every id must pass the strict
   783	      // ID grammar. The provided followUp.followUpCaseId MUST be a member of the
   784	      // experiment's declared follow-up case ids — otherwise a caller could submit a
   785	      // followUp object pointing at an arbitrary case while the experiment's actual
   786	      // follow-up linkage was empty (or sparse) and the classifier would still produce
   787	      // a confirmed outcome despite the linkage break.
   788	      var followUpIdsR = _snapshotArrayShape(experiment.followUpCaseIds || [], CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID);
   789	      if (followUpIdsR.valid !== true) {
   790	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(followUpIdsR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'experiment.followUpCaseIds: ' + followUpIdsR.detail });
   791	      }
   792	      var declaredFollowUpIds = followUpIdsR.snapshot;
   793	      var followUpDeclared = false;
   794	      for (var fui = 0; fui < declaredFollowUpIds.length; fui++) {
   795	        if (!_idGrammarOk(declaredFollowUpIds[fui])) {
   796	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment.followUpCaseIds[' + fui + '] invalid id' });
   797	        }
   798	        if (declaredFollowUpIds[fui] === followUp.followUpCaseId) followUpDeclared = true;
   799	      }
   800	      if (!followUpDeclared) {
   801	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.LINKAGE_INVALID], { detail: 'followUp.followUpCaseId not declared in experiment.followUpCaseIds' });
   802	      }
   803	      // parentCaseId binding — followUp's parent MUST be the experiment's source case. If
   804	      // parentCaseId mismatches, treat as invalid_comparison (cross-case forbidden).
   805	      var crossCase = (followUp.parentCaseId !== experiment.sourceCaseId);
   806	      var crossSession = (followUp.sessionId !== followUp.parentSessionId);
   807	      var noExplicitReference = (followUp.hasExplicitReference !== true);
   808	      var lowComparability = (followUp.comparabilityScore < MIN_COMPARABILITY_FOR_VALID_COMPARISON);
   809	
   810	      // ---- Step 9: resolve freshness reference (clock AT MOST ONCE, post-authority) ------
   811	      var refNowMs = null;
   812	      var resolvedClockIso = null;
   813	      if (typeof optsSnap.referenceNowMs === 'number' && _CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(optsSnap.referenceNowMs) && optsSnap.referenceNowMs >= 0) {
   814	        refNowMs = optsSnap.referenceNowMs;
   815	      } else if (typeof optsSnap.clock === 'function') {
   816	        var clockIso = null;
   817	        try { clockIso = optsSnap.clock(); } catch (eClock) { clockIso = null; }
   818	        if (typeof clockIso === 'string' && clockIso.length > 0) {
   819	          var clockMs = _isoToMs(clockIso);
   820	          if (typeof clockMs === 'number') {
   821	            refNowMs = clockMs;
   822	            resolvedClockIso = clockIso;
   823	          }
   824	        }
   825	      }
   826	      if (typeof refNowMs !== 'number' || refNowMs !== refNowMs) {
   827	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'unable to resolve reference time (opts.clock missing or invalid)' });
   828	      }
   829	      var maxAgeMs = (typeof optsSnap.maxAgeMs === 'number') ? optsSnap.maxAgeMs : DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_MS;
   830	
   831	      // ---- Step 10: freshness check ------------------------------------------------------
   832	      var expCreatedMs = _isoToMs(experiment.createdAt);
   833	      var changeAppliedMs = _isoToMs(appliedChange.appliedAt);
   834	      if (expCreatedMs !== null && (refNowMs - expCreatedMs) > maxAgeMs) {
   835	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'experiment exceeds max age' });
   836	      }
   837	      if (changeAppliedMs !== null && (refNowMs - changeAppliedMs) > maxAgeMs) {
   838	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'appliedChange exceeds max age' });
   839	      }
   840	
   841	      // ---- Step 11: comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence) ------
   842	      var limitations = [];
   843	      var classDecision = null;
   844	      var confounders = [];
   845	
   846	      if (crossCase || crossSession || noExplicitReference || lowComparability) {
   847	        classDecision = 'invalid_comparison';

   853	        }
   854	      } else {
   855	        // ---- Step 12: control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders) ------

   858	        // ambient Object.create rebind cannot inject phantom membership.
   859	        // Codex E3-R2-03 closure: experiment.controlVariables MUST be dense + index-only

   873	          if (!_nonEmptyStr(declaredName)) continue;

   878	        if (confounders.length > 0) {
   879	          classDecision = 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders';
   880	          if (limitations.indexOf(CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING) === -1) {
   881	            limitations.push(CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING);
   882	          }

   884	          // Out-of-range CVs become confounders.
   885	          var outOfRange = [];
   886	          for (var ki = 0; ki < controlVariableObservations.length; ki++) {

   889	          }

   891	            classDecision = 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders';
   892	            confounders = outOfRange;
   893	            if (limitations.indexOf(CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_OUT_OF_RANGE) === -1) {
   894	              limitations.push(CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_OUT_OF_RANGE);
   895	            }
   896	          } else if (controlVariableObservations.length === 0) {
   897	            // No control variables AT ALL — the experiment did not declare any, and none
   898	            // were observed. The outcome can still be classified, but we flag the

   900	            if (limitations.indexOf(CODES.LIMITATION_NO_CONTROL_VARIABLES) === -1) {
   901	              limitations.push(CODES.LIMITATION_NO_CONTROL_VARIABLES);
   902	            }
   903	          }
   904	        }
   905	
   906	        // ---- Step 13: data quality + direction/magnitude classification cascade --------
   907	        if (classDecision === null) {
   908	          var dataQualityBlocking = dataQualityIssues.length > DATA_QUALITY_ISSUE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD;
   909	          var hasContradictions = contradictingEvidenceIds.length > 0;
   910	          var directionMatch = (observation.observedDirection === experiment.expectedDirection);
   911	          var magnitudeInRange = (
   912	            observation.observedMagnitude !== null
   913	              && _isFiniteNumber(observation.observedMagnitude)
   914	              && observation.observedMagnitude >= experiment.expectedMagnitudeRange.min
   915	              && observation.observedMagnitude <= experiment.expectedMagnitudeRange.max
   916	          );
   917	
   918	          if (dataQualityBlocking) {
   919	            classDecision = 'inconclusive';
   920	            // Carry the data-quality codes as limitations so the UI can show them honestly.
   921	            for (var dqi = 0; dqi < dataQualityIssues.length && limitations.length < ARRAY_CAP; dqi++) {
   922	              if (limitations.indexOf(dataQualityIssues[dqi]) === -1) limitations.push(dataQualityIssues[dqi]);
   923	            }
   924	          } else if (observation.observedDirection === null) {
   925	            classDecision = 'inconclusive';
   926	          } else if (hasContradictions) {
   927	            // Contradicting evidence blocks confirmed; treat as contradicted irrespective of
   928	            // direction match (the contradicting evidence is itself evidence to the contrary).
   929	            classDecision = 'contradicted';
   930	          } else if (!directionMatch) {
   931	            classDecision = 'contradicted';
   932	          } else if (magnitudeInRange) {
   933	            classDecision = 'confirmed';
   934	          } else {
   935	            classDecision = 'partially_confirmed';
   936	          }
   937	        }
   938	      }
   939	
   940	      // ---- Step 14: compose outcome ------------------------------------------------------
   941	      var createdAtIso = resolvedClockIso || appliedChange.appliedAt || experiment.createdAt;
   942	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(createdAtIso) || _isoToMs(createdAtIso) === null) {
   943	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'could not resolve outcome createdAt ISO' });
   944	      }
   945	      var outcomeIdStr = _outcomeId(experiment.experimentId, appliedChange.changeId);
   946	      // Bound the limitations array.
   947	      if (limitations.length > ARRAY_CAP) limitations = limitations.slice(0, ARRAY_CAP);
   948	
   949	      var outcome = {
   950	        schemaVersion: OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION,
   951	        outcomeId: outcomeIdStr,
   952	        experimentId: experiment.experimentId,
   953	        'class': classDecision,
   954	        observedDirection: observation.observedDirection,
   955	        observedMagnitude: observation.observedMagnitude,
   956	        comparabilityScore: followUp.comparabilityScore,
   957	        confounders: confounders.slice(),

   959	        dataQualityIssues: dataQualityIssues.slice(),
   960	        sideEffects: sideEffects.slice(),

   963	      };
   964	
   965	      // ---- Step 15: validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape -----------------------------
   966	      var outCheck = OUT.validateOutcomeShape(outcome);
   967	      if (outCheck.valid !== true) {

   970	          { detail: 'composed outcome failed E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape' }
   971	        );
   972	      }
   973	
   974	      // ---- Step 16: envelope byte cap ----------------------------------------------------
   975	      var envelopeBytes;
   976	      try { envelopeBytes = _utf8Bytes(_CAPTURED_JSON_STRINGIFY(outcome)); }
   977	      catch (e) { envelopeBytes = Infinity; }

   980	      }
   981	
   982	      // ---- Step 17: re-check intrinsics post-classify, deep-freeze, register -------------
   983	      if (!_intrinsicsIntact()) {
   984	        return _buildTamperBlock('intrinsic tampering detected post-classify');
   985	      }
   986	      _deepFreeze(outcome);
   987	      _registerAuthoritativeOutcome(outcome);
   988	
   989	      return _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE({ valid: true, outcome: outcome });
   990	
   991	    } catch (eOuter) {
   992	      return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'classifyOutcome threw on hostile input' });
   993	    }
   994	  }
   995	
   996	  // ---------- Public API ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   997	  var api = {
   998	    SERVICE_VERSION: SERVICE_VERSION,
   999	    OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION: OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  1000	    ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP: ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP,
  1001	    MIN_COMPARABILITY_FOR_VALID_COMPARISON: MIN_COMPARABILITY_FOR_VALID_COMPARISON,
  1002	    DATA_QUALITY_ISSUE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD: DATA_QUALITY_ISSUE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD,
  1003	    classifyOutcome: classifyOutcome,
  1004	    verifyAuthoritativeOutcome: verifyAuthoritativeOutcome,
  1005	  };
  1006	  _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(api);
  1007	  if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
  1008	    module.exports = api;
  1009	  } else if (root) {
  1010	    try { Object.defineProperty(root, 'R3_0E_OutcomeClassifier', { value: api, writable: false, enumerable: false, configurable: false }); }
  1011	    catch (e) { root.R3_0E_OutcomeClassifier = api; }
  1012	  }

    62	
    63	      var reasons = [];
    64	      if (!Number.isInteger(o.schemaVersion)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    65	      else if (o.schemaVersion > SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION) reasons.push(CODES.UNSUPPORTED_FUTURE_SCHEMA);
    66	      else if (o.schemaVersion < 1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    67

    69	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(o.experimentId)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    70	      if (OUTCOME_CLASS_ALLOWED.indexOf(o['class']) === -1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_CLASS_INVALID);
    71	      if (o.observedDirection !== null && ['increase', 'decrease', 'no_change'].indexOf(o.observedDirection) === -1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    72	      if (o.observedMagnitude !== null && typeof o.observedMagnitude !== 'number') reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    73	      if (typeof o.comparabilityScore !== 'number' || o.comparabilityScore < 0 || o.comparabilityScore > 1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT);
    74	      if (!Array.isArray(o.confounders) || o.confounders.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    75	      if (o.driverFeedback !== null && !_nonEmptyStr(o.driverFeedback)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_DRIVER_FEEDBACK_INVALID);
    76	      if (!Array.isArray(o.dataQualityIssues) || o.dataQualityIssues.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID);
